questions.title: Which statement best describes a function?
choices: Each input has exactly one output
Each input can have multiple outputs
A function must always be linear
A function must always be increasing
questions.explain: A function assigns exactly one output to each input.

questions.title: Which relation below IS a function?
questions.explain: Each input must map to only one output.

questions.title: Which of the following represents a linear function?
questions.explain: Linear functions have the form f(x) = mx + b.

questions.title: Evaluate the function: f(x) = 3x - 2. What is f(4)?
Which graph feature indicates a function is increasing?
choices: The graph moves upward from left to right
The graph moves downward from left to right
questions.explain: Increasing functions rise from left to right.

questions.title: Which graph feature indicates a function is decreasing?
choices: The graph moves upward from left to right
The graph moves downward from left to right
questions.explain: Decreasing functions fall from left to right.

questions.title: A piecewise function uses:
choices: Different formulas depending on the interval of x
questions.explain: Piecewise functions change formulas based on x.

questions.title:
Given the piecewise function:

f(x) = x + 2 if x < 0
       5     if x ≥ 0

What is f(0)?
questions.explain: Since 0 ≥ 0, use the second piece: f(0) = 5.

questions.title: Which inequality corresponds to a closed circle on a graph?
questions.explain: ≤ or ≥ includes the endpoint, so it is closed.

questions.title: Which inequality corresponds to an open circle on a graph?
questions.explain: < or > means the endpoint is not included.

questions.title: If f(x) = x² and g(x) = x + 3, what is (f ∘ g)(2)?
If f(x) = x + 1 and g(x) = 3x, what is (g ∘ f)(x)?
Which description best matches decomposing a function?
choices: Breaking a function into two simpler functions
Finding the inverse of a function
questions.explain: Decomposition means splitting a function into two parts.

questions.title: Why is a piecewise function still considered a function?
choices: Because each input has exactly one output
Because each input has multiple outputs
Because the graph is always continuous
questions.explain: A function must assign one output per input, even if formulas change.
